title: Github actions for web templates is in extra zip
body: ### Tested versions repro in actions produced in hash 45a98064e977c70caf44b6abd1c9717d0ea736f6 ### System information Godot v4.7.mychanges711 (cae877e9f) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 22 May 2026 19:25:09 +0000 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Single-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon 780M Graphics (radeonsi, phoenix, ACO, DRM 3.64, 7.0.9-arch2-1) - AMD Ryzen 7 8745HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 28.18 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono) ### Issue description When downloading the actions artifact "web-template" (like from here https://github.com/godotengine/godot/actions/runs/30319459396?pr=121844), I would expect this to be the zip that I should point godot to in the custom template section. But that does not work. (The correct action is below.) After unzipping the `web-template.zip` file, these are the contents (only `godot.web.template_release.wasm64.zip` is needed for users to export to web. That is the correct zip file to point the custom template release path to.) So it seems that some extra files are included in the zip file the action outputs. I believe the action could be changed to just directly make `godot.web.template_release.wasm64.zip` be the downloadable artifact. ### Steps to reproduce listed above ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) N/A
